'''Barnaby''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] technician who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], he served on board the [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Yamarus/Legends|Yamarus]].
